name: voice-corpus
description: Model- and harness-agnostic personal-voice corpus builder. Pulls your own writing from any source (iMessage, Slack, Discord, email/mbox, your own articles, or any text export) through one shared cleaning + anti-AI-slop + length-tiering pipeline, then emits a JSONL corpus plus a portable 'voice pack' prompt that makes any LLM write in your real voice. Pure-stdlib core; new sources are a one-file adapter. See references/RESEARCH.md for the evidence (why corpus exemplars beat prompting, and when a local fine-tune wins instead).
